checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan: add Basu 2023 binaural-beats cognition meta-analysis as context and add a new no-binaural-beats claim boundary

impact_assessment.benefits: Adds aave context record and a new claim boundary distinguishing the app from entrainment gimmicks.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Verify via efetch, update records/references/counts/version, add bounded boundary citation with tests, run suites and review UI.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: one context record, one new UI boundary bullet with citation, count/version updates; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: counts, references and version must move together
impact_assessment.why: A verified 2023 meta-analysis found a medium pooled effect for binaural beats on memory/attention but conflicting, parameter-dependent results and calls for robust designs, grounding a new bounded app statement that it uses no auditory entrainment.
